Composite Friction Factor (Φ) = (Macro × 0.35) + (YEKDEM × 0.30) + (Dorad × 0.20) + (Illiquidity × 0.15)
• Bear (Floor): max(50.0c, Raw Recovery × 0.65 × (1 - Φ))
• Base (Fair): Raw Recovery × (1 - Φ × 0.35)
• Bull (Upside): min(100.0c, Raw Recovery × 1.15)
